title: feat(lockp): unique-lock inversion sample is all-odd
science: Inversion parity of unique earliest incoming locks: 60 formed antipodal pairs {x,-x}, 25 with unique locks at both ends, and ALL 25 are odd, L(-x) = -L(x); N_even=N_other=0. The lock field transforms as a polar vector under spatial inversion on its unique-lock subsample. Note explicitly refuses to write P or V-A into Admissibility.
